maria (AE): SentinelCare wants a quick acceptance run: sustain 120 qps p99 <350ms, 3x 2m microbursts to 800 qps, KMS in-path. Can we do a reproducible test tomorrow?

sam (SE): Yep. Proposed: 30m soak @120 qps then 3 microbursts (2m) to 800 qps spaced 4m. Compare f32 baseline vs 4-bit quant + KV cache. Collect p50/p95/p99, GPU util, host queue depth, kernel fallback counts, and KMS call latencies.

ana (SRE): Note KMS tends to add tail when decrypts pile up. If customer terminates TLS at ALB we see extra copies; request passthrough reduces that. Ask them to confirm.

zoe (ops): I can spin a temp 3xA100 pool + 1 standby. Batching target 16, max concurrency per GPU conservative. Will open loadgen IP and metrics.

sam (SE): Repro commands:
```bash
# soak 30m
hey -z 30m -q 120 -c 250 -m POST -d '{"prompt":"test"}' https://staging.redwood/v1/gen
# 3 bursts 2m to 800 qps
for i in 1 2 3; do hey -z 2m -q 800 -c 800 -m POST -d '{"prompt":"x"}' https://staging.redwood/v1/gen; sleep 240; done
```

ci-bot: deploy: temp-pool-sentinel-5300 started, ETA 9m.

sam (SE): Quick post-run notes: baseline f32 p99 ~290ms no KMS; with KMS p99 ~340ms with spikes. Quant steady p99 ~480ms; during bursts quant p99 hit ~640ms. GPU util steady ~68% -> ~95% peak. Host CPU queuing visible at bursts.

ana (SRE): Traces show KMS decrypts correlated with tail spikes. Short-term: pre-warm tokens and increase proxy workers; that shaved ~10ms off tail in a rerun. Long-term: async decrypt or HSM off hot path.

maria (AE): Sales needs cost notes: dedicated monthly for pool and prorated test, hosted burst per-peak-qps-minute, and token-cost delta. Sam/zoe can you draft numbers?

zoe (ops): Draft: Dedicated (3xA100+standby) ~$7,200/month; prorated 4h test ~$850. Hosted burst estimate $0.095/peak-qps-minute (single 2m 800-qps burst ~ $152). Token delta: quant raw saves ~16-20% but infra overhead reduces net to ~10-12%.

maria (AE): Thanks. Next: sam to drop a 1-page runbook + CSV, ana to draft KMS/security answers, zoe to finalize cost notes. I'll set Friday 9am PT call with customer.
